'''Jj'abot''' was a board game. The playing pieces included pawns and knights. The game was a central prop used in a play performed by [[Jaalib Brandl]] on [[Garos IV]].<ref name="BBK">{{JournalCite|12|Betrayal by Knight}}</ref>
